scripts.dev:all: bunx concurrently -n frontend,backend,python -c green,blue,magenta "bunx turbo run dev --filter=frontend" "bunx turbo run dev --filter=backend" "bun run dev:python"
scripts.clean: bunx turbo run clean && rm -rf node_modules .turbo
scripts.clean:all: bunx turbo run clean:all && rm -rf node_modules .turbo bun.lockb
scripts.setup:python: cd apps/data-service && python3 -m venv venv && (source venv/bin/activate || . venv/Scripts/activate) && pip install -r requirements.txt
